# The compiled binary opens canonical roots without changing primary or linked Git state.
cp seed-tabs $ZWM_TEST_TABS

# Snapshot the attached primary worktree before bare, absolute, and relative opens.
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project rev-parse HEAD
cp stdout primary-before-head
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project symbolic-ref -q HEAD
cp stdout primary-before-symbolic
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project status --porcelain=v2 -z
cp stdout primary-before-status
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project for-each-ref
cp stdout primary-before-refs
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project worktree list --porcelain -z
cp stdout primary-before-worktrees

# A stale project:feature tab does not collide with the root project title.
exec zwm o project
cmpenv stdout primary-created
! stderr .
exec zwm o $HOME/code/project
cmpenv stdout primary-focused
! stderr .
cd $HOME/code
exec zwm o ./project
cmpenv stdout $WORK/primary-focused
! stderr .
cd $WORK

exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project rev-parse HEAD
cmp stdout primary-before-head
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project symbolic-ref -q HEAD
cmp stdout primary-before-symbolic
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project status --porcelain=v2 -z
cmp stdout primary-before-status
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project for-each-ref
cmp stdout primary-before-refs
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project worktree list --porcelain -z
cmp stdout primary-before-worktrees

# An external newline-containing project path remains a single argv value.
exec zwm o $ZWM_TEST_NEWLINE_PROJECT
cmpenv stdout newline-created
! stderr .

# A dirty linked worktree opens the canonical root while preserving both worktrees byte-for-byte.
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project worktree add --quiet -b feature/open-linked $WORK/open-linked
cp dirty $WORK/open-linked/tracked.txt
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project rev-parse HEAD
cp stdout linked-primary-before-head
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project symbolic-ref -q HEAD
cp stdout linked-primary-before-symbolic
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project status --porcelain=v2 -z
cp stdout linked-primary-before-status
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project for-each-ref
cp stdout linked-primary-before-refs
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project worktree list --porcelain -z
cp stdout linked-primary-before-worktrees
exec realgit -C $WORK/open-linked rev-parse HEAD
cp stdout linked-before-head
exec realgit -C $WORK/open-linked symbolic-ref -q HEAD
cp stdout linked-before-symbolic
exec realgit -C $WORK/open-linked status --porcelain=v2 -z
cp stdout linked-before-status
exec realgit -C $WORK/open-linked for-each-ref
cp stdout linked-before-refs
exec realgit -C $WORK/open-linked worktree list --porcelain -z
cp stdout linked-before-worktrees

cd $WORK/open-linked
exec zwm o .
cmpenv stdout $WORK/linked-focused
! stderr .
cd $WORK

exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project rev-parse HEAD
cmp stdout linked-primary-before-head
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project symbolic-ref -q HEAD
cmp stdout linked-primary-before-symbolic
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project status --porcelain=v2 -z
cmp stdout linked-primary-before-status
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project for-each-ref
cmp stdout linked-primary-before-refs
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project worktree list --porcelain -z
cmp stdout linked-primary-before-worktrees
exec realgit -C $WORK/open-linked rev-parse HEAD
cmp stdout linked-before-head
exec realgit -C $WORK/open-linked symbolic-ref -q HEAD
cmp stdout linked-before-symbolic
exec realgit -C $WORK/open-linked status --porcelain=v2 -z
cmp stdout linked-before-status
exec realgit -C $WORK/open-linked for-each-ref
cmp stdout linked-before-refs
exec realgit -C $WORK/open-linked worktree list --porcelain -z
cmp stdout linked-before-worktrees
assert-log $ZWM_TEST_LOG want-log

-- seed-tabs --
project:feature
-- dirty --
initial
dirty
-- primary-created --
project_root=$HOME/code/project
tab_action=created
tab_title=project
tab_cwd=$HOME/code/project
-- primary-focused --
project_root=$HOME/code/project
tab_action=focused
tab_title=project
tab_cwd=$HOME/code/project
-- newline-created --
project_root=$WORK/external/newline
project
tab_action=created
tab_title=$ZWM_TEST_NEWLINE_KEY
tab_cwd=$WORK/external/newline
project
-- linked-focused --
project_root=$HOME/code/project
tab_action=focused
tab_title=project
tab_cwd=$HOME/code/project
-- want-log --
